name: english-real-audio-clip-presence-v1
threshold_policy: Highest calibration-positive score threshold allowing at most floor(0.01*Npositive) misses; apply unchanged on development.
training_budget_includes: Process startup, imports, cache verification, optimizer updates and checkpoint writing; reserve20seconds for export
deployment_weight_precision: All learned conv and head codes ternary, per-tensor derivedFP32scale; no bias/no affine normalization
cpu_workload: One second mono16k PCM to DSP and classifier on one remote x86 CPUthread
label_semantics: Full3–20second English transcript-bearing utterances contain speech; source-labeled non-speech noise segments. No activity labels for individual frames.
limits: Corpus differences may inflate classification; noise labels not individually audited
No quiet/noisy speech conditions validated in this initial clean-speech proxy
